g.text: Small barn B 62% on wet soil · arena 18% · cattle barn B 9%
A. Slide the north row 12' south
Small barn B 48% on wet soil · arena 5% · cattle barn B 0%
Barn B, the arena, cattle barn B and their turnouts all move
12' south. The gap between barn rows drops from 24' to 12'.
B. Swap barn B and the arena
Small barn B 18% on wet soil · arena 62% · cattle barn B 9%
Barn B takes the middle strip; the arena moves to the west run.
The arena, not a barn, ends up on the wet corner.
C. Barn B beside barn A
Small barn B 0% on wet soil · arena 18% · cattle barn B 9%
Both small animal barns in the south row, side by side, each
with a turnout. The north-west corner is left as pasture.
D. Barn B in the middle strip, south of the arena
Small barn B 0% on wet soil · arena 18% · cattle barn B 9%
Barn B goes where the feed containers are; the containers move
to the west run's north slot. Barn B has no turnout of its own.
F. Everything new 48' south and 12' west
Small barn B 18% on wet soil · arena 0% · cattle barn B 0%
Every new element, the parking and handling yard included,
moves 48' south and 12' west. The existing barn and pens stay
E. C, plus slide the arena and cattle barn B 12' south
Small barn B 0% on wet soil · arena 5% · cattle barn B 0%
Barn B beside barn A, and the two remaining north-row buildings
pulled 12' south. Only a corner of the arena (5%) is left on
Barnyard diagram frame, in feet, all panels at one scale. Existing barn at the bottom right; north is roughly up.
